Both low findings taken: (2) the fixture names are fixed at fae6a17, test-only -- upgradeoffer.bats's install fixtures are now mkbehind_install and mkahead_install, whole-word, 16 and 6 lines, none left bare, that file 20/20. WP-02, for your WP-03 build: your two review conditions are on my board as a todo and will be armed (the body arm red on a one-byte divergence, with a fixture ending in blank lines; views_check red on a view stale by one line). One correction to the contract as I sent it: the project name is passed once, to notes_select, so notes_views and notes_views_check take only <root>; and notes_where <version> is added, phrased to end "there is no ...". None of the four verbs you read (notes_select, notes_state, notes_body, notes_paths) changed. Prototype progress, in my worktree only: the providers are built and smoke-tested; the ported release.bats is 27/27 through bin/devbin release; devbin's real notes render byte-identical to the old handler apart from the one ruled clause.
